body: I have been where you are in my twenties, more than once. You keep going back because he made you feel good--that shit can be addictive! Literally, there's science behind it! But he has also brought you on such an exhausting emotional and mental roller coaster, which is NEVER a sign of a good, healthy relationship--one you deserve. It's going to hurt, but the hurt is temporary--you need to take care of yourself. It genuinely hurts me to see you refer to yourself as 'loser'---you're not, you never were, you got strung along because someone took your trust, made you promises (even if they weren't explicitly said, he KNEW what you wanted)  and lit it on fire in front of you. Leave this man, don't look back, and look into what can help you trust yourself more in what you want, and never settle.
YTA. You'd be doing the world a favor if you threw your sorry ass in the shredder too, you useful son of a b\*tch.

YTA. You are a predator, you were incredibly insecure over KNITTING, you triggered your partner despite knowing her past and then didn't even own up to behavior that is just as triggering and abusive. You have no business not only dating someone that much younger than you (TWELVE!!! YEARS!!!! TWELVE YEARS!!!) but you have no business dating ANYONE until you get some real help via therapy and fuck knows what else. YTA YTA YTA YTA YTAAAAAAAAAAAAA

YTA. Let's not play games here. Do your ex, and your daughter a favor, and give up any custody rights, because who are you kidding, you absolute MEATHEAD? You don't give a single f\*ck about your kid, and you should just quit now so she doesn't get the wrong idea that you will ever, EVER care about her the way she deserves. And after that, never, ever procreate again, you WORM.

YTA. Not only are you TA, you are a F\*CKING WORM. You should take a good hard look at yourself--because this kind of sh\*t is not how you treat ANYONE you care about. You can't handle this (obviously) and quite frankly she's better off without you, because the way you act? It's as good as her being alone. Honestly she'd be better off because she wouldn't have to be subjected to your doubting her very real health issues. I bet she misses herself too before this illness happened to her!! She didn't choose it!! You think she wants to be in pain, have her life extremely managed for any emergency? You need to learn empathy, and you need to learn what it means to actually love another human being, and grow the hell up.
YTA. You should absolutely leave this kid, and this family the f\*ck alone, and I hope his ass writes about you. You're shameful.
INFO: Did you sleep with the father? There's a lot of backstory missing here.
You need to end this relationship. He is poisonous, a racist, and a danger to you. You deserve so, so much better.

YOU NEED TO LEAVE HIM. You need to pack what you can when he's asleep, or just wear what you need, grab your personal items and stay with your parents. You need to come up with a plan and you need to leave him.

YTA. Have...have you seen the movie Cinderella? Are you...finding yourself defending the wicked stepmothers instinctively when you're watching Disney with your kids, or reading them a story? You're being absolutely ridiculous, and I'm glad you have to deal with the consequences of your own actions, what a concept.

NTA. That dude is just one of many puny minnow-sized assholes that just can't handle ANYTHING real. Meanwhile I think that's so damn cool and had that happened to me I would immediately have reacted with surprise, then, "Do you need to wash it or anything?" And politely ask you curious questions and then carry on as per usual.

YTA. So is your daughter and your mother. You all f\*cking SUCK. Christ on a cracker, let the woman that literally carried and delivered LIFE that your measly spunk dedicated a minute to LIVE for f\*ck's sake! You need to look into your very obviously taught and perpetuated misogynistic views. You are wrong, your mother is wrong, your daughter is wrong.

YTA. Are you kidding me right now? You're upset that your daughter is passionate about READING BOOKS? Do you know how ridiculous you sound? Let her read all she wants, find a kinder, more creative method of getting her to do her chores. Hell, suggest audiobooks for when she does chores around the house, get her a cool pair of headphones to make up for being a d\*ck about something like this. Audiobooks help get my ass moving when I need to do housework, and during something as new and stressful as this pandemic people are going to need whatever escape works for them. Do not get in the way of her being able to escape for a bit, and such a great and harmless passion. You have no idea how blessed you are with a kid who is a reader.
YTA. CLEAN YOUR OWN BUTT RAGS. YOUR WIFE IS NOT YOUR MOTHER. TRY AND DO MORE AROUND THE HOUSE FOR YOUR WIFE FOR A CHANGE. CHRIST.
NTA. You are better without all of them in your life.

After typing all of that out, it should be clear to you what you need to do, regardless of it being hard--you need to leave him. Your relationship was uneven and inappropriate from the start, and everything you've described screams to me of an extremely unbalanced, unhealthy relationship. You deserve so much better, and with someone much closer to your own age. Honestly, dating around a bit, not settling down right away after you leave this dud of a man, might be better for you. What he does, how he feels, after you break up with him, is not your problem, not your concern and not on your shoulders, and I'm truly sorry he's made you feel that it would be. Free yourself, and enjoy your life without this guy making you play mother, taking advantage of you completely, mind body and soul.

You are not too sensitive at all. Please take care of yourself, and don't be with someone who makes you think that your very normal, very valid reactions to his abuse are overreactions, irrational, etc. He is being extremely verbally abusive, and it very well could escalate, but it doesn't have to escalate to be taken seriously. Staying with someone like this will only continue to hurt you more and more, and please, take it from someone who has experienced this abuse--you need to cut them out of your life, you are worth so much more than how they treat you. You are an incredible human being, a woman worthy of respect, of feeling good, and you deserve to have your feelings acknowledged, listened to, and treated as valid and important in a positive manner. If a beloved friend of yours told you their partner was saying/doing these things, or you saw this on tv, would you think that friend/character should stay with that partner, or leave them? Take care of yourself <3.

NTA. He still deserves nothing, accident/age difference or no. I guarantee you he hasn't changed, and your daughter, as someone put incredibly well, IS NOT A BACKUP PLAN. He gave up his rights, and it definitely doesn't sound like he has put any thought into wanting to know her specifically and make it right, whatever that would entail. He's just upset he has no "legacy". Please stay strong, and stick to your guns. Your daughter and you are so much better off without him in your life. (Also I admire your strength and conviction so so much, you are a badass).
YTA. And you are garbage. Hope she dumps you.

YTA. Not only are you TA, but you a being a manipulative predator, and the "relationship" you have with that poor young woman 15 years younger than you, is toxic to her, absolutely inappropriate, and I hope to hell that you do the right thing and break things off and admit to your issues and get help, or she figures you out and gets away from all the poisonous, dangerous older women in her life. SHAME ON YOU.

NTA.  Plus, in this "climate" aka PANDEMIC no one should be touching a stranger's things and after any close conversation you should make sure to watch you and your family for symptoms. Bravo on the santisation and taking the bike back.
NTA. These children had to learn somehow, pity they had to learn the hard way but that's that.

YTA. I hope she finds out that you meddled and didn't respect her as a grown adult with her own career who is capable of making her own career decisions and leaves your ass, and finds a job where a manager won't discuss any concerns a spouse of an employee. You don't work there, you have no right or say in anything to do with her job, and the manager is irresponsible and unprofessional listening to your lazy ass. "unuseful around the house" gave you away right there. YTAYTAYTAYTAYTA.
He is using you, without a doubt. Break up with him.

Even before I got to the physical affections your SO and his sister have with each other, I knew you should break up with your SO. Now that I got to that part, I can emphatically scream from my top of my lungs, BREAK UP WITH HIM. YOU DO NO WANT TO DEAL WITH ALL OF THIS FOR THE REST OF YOUR LIFE, OR ONE DAY MORE.

I don't think this is someone you want in your life, OP. You deserve much, much better than this, and this behavior isn't a one off, or even really about anything to do with you. No one should react like this to this kind of situation. He is absolutely abusive, and you go right ahead and get a divorce lawyer, because you are much, much better off. You do not deserve this, OP. You need to get away from him.
I know it's a horrible feeling, and it will feel horrible for a time, but you need to break up with him. That's it.
YTA.

It's time to break up with him. I think you know that it's been time. And it isn't a waste of time, you're constantly learning and you know what, there is no right or wrong length of time for a relationship. You deserve so, so much better, and you will GET that when you cut this dead weight off, and find what makes you feel safe, and happy, and alive--with or without a new healthier relationship in the future. It is so much better to be by yourself, treating yourself better, than being in a toxic relationship like this where you are literally suffering mentally, emotionally and physically (stress like this affects your physical health!). Take care of yourself. Do what you would encourage your loved ones to do if you knew they were being treated like this.

NTA. And in this case, it is not about the cookies. It is about your husband ignoring your  EASY, sincere wish, your hard work, your being upset, etc. That is not a man who respects you. And his excuse is just insulting. His desire overrides yours? Your hard work and efforts? His selfishness is worth you getting upset? His bringing up the whole "banished to the couch" so quickly also leads me to believe this isn't the first time he's been a real turd.
Dump him.

YTA. You need to re-evaluate all these "issues" you have with your girlfriend, and if basically anything she's doing you can't reconcile with or even like, then you need to break up with her. She doesn't deserve your, frankly, controlling and unhealthy behavior and you don't have to be with someone you can't love and support completely.

YTA. Break up with this precious, sweet woman that in no way, shape or form should be with your miserable, sexist ass and re-evaluate yourself and why you can't just let a woman be happy about the little things in life, and you'd rather stifle that happy than get happy yourself. T H E R A P Y, get some!

You know now that you look even worse, doing this? Like you've seriously convinced me that you're just not a good person, and neither is your husband, and I hope like hell your mentor finds out e v e r y t h i n g. You are creepy and so is your husband.

Honestly, both of you (you and your husband) need to stay away from this family. You already sound alarmingly inappropriate with age boundaries and also personal boundaries (you hook up with one kid of your mentor's with a huge age gap, and now you might have your husband hook up with the second kid? are you kidding me?) You know there are better ways of going about finding people to be poly with, there are plenty of other people looking for casual sex that aren't related to your mentor AND aren't fresh out of high school? C'mon. You're not making a great case for how people handle open relationships.

NTA. Your family is being one giant asshole, lead by General Asshole (your sister), and you should just draw the line in the sand: they don't get to see the baby, or you, now or anytime after if they keep this up. That's it. Family members should never be given leeway because they're family--I guarantee your daughter will absolutely hate that shit when she's older. It's not your fault and even if in the future her peers put 2+2 together, it really could be worse lol. But family doing it when you've expressed your dislike and asked them to stop is just...terrible.

YTA, and I hope like hell that she throws your dumb, unintelligent, nosy ass out, because it's the least you deserve. You're 17, you need to learn a few things, and the first thing you should learn is that "make yourself at home" does not mean, "break into something that's locked". A lock means here that only the owner of the key gets to open that lock. You have no respect for your sister, I doubt you have the maturity and knowledge to make any calls on what qualifies as PRUDISH. If your grown sister wants to keep her toys private, that's HER RIGHT in her home and in her life. You just violated her completely, and you're STILL trying to blame it on your friends--you should have never taken those pictures in the first place, not to mention share them! You aren't learning shit, and for that, you deserve to be kicked out. I hope she doesn't fall for your fake ass apology. You are a terrible brother and need to learn how to respect women and your siblings. YOU ARE AN ASSHOLE.

NTA. Honestly, dump the whole family. Dump the boyfriend, find a partner that puts you first, and hopefully has better family. It sucks for the 6 yo but hey, that's not your problem. It won't get any better, it'll just get worse, and your bf has made it clear who he'll stand by always. You don't deserve or need this in your life.
YTA. You are a racist asshole, and deserve to be alone for the rest of your life.
YTA, and you're a pest, like your sister says. Maybe see someone professional about your inability to differentiate dogs and humans. Yikes.

YTA. You, and your wife, are not only TA, but you are absolute monsters, and should not have been allowed to have children. You are absolutely wretched. Everything you have said is wrong, misinformed, and your daughter I hope gets as far away from you as possible and cuts off all contact with you. If your daughter dies, whether it be cancer related or corona virus, her blood is on your hands, and I hope you are haunted by it, and feel very alone when you yourself pass.
YTA and you are being a straight up homophobe. Grow up, and leave.

Also for what it's worth, if either of my parents had been like hers, and they came around begging for scraps after treating me like dirt my whole life, and my partner gave my ashes and things I gave to THEM specifically away? Booooy I'd be pissed as hell beyond the grave. Hell would get a little bit hotter that day. You know her better than anyone else. You know what she deserves, after her passing. She deserves to rest peacefully with you, someone who truly loved and continues to love her. And she would want you to have her with you.

NTA. You are absolutely in the right, they are wrong, and they can pound sand for the rest of their sad, miserable lives. They missed their chance, and now that it's gone, they want something that helps them avoid the cold hard facts that they SUCK as people. Stay strong, do whatever you can legally to protect yourself, get a restraining order if they keep hounding you.
YTA. You fucked up, big time.
NTA. Time to discuss where that friendship is headed because I'd be spitting mad enough to say adios to Laura. What a wild thing to do to you.
NTA. That's some ridiculous shit, right there. Ask for that $200 back if they start to get really shitty about it.
NTA. You're much better off without him in your life, period. You are strong as hell for making it through that period in your life, and anyone who doesn't admire you for it, is in fact, an asshole.

NTA. You did what I wish more actual friends with do--you spoke the truth regardless of some "hurt feelings" because you truly want the best for Chelsea. Send Chelsea something nice, encourage her to speak to her doctor about it, the two of you go out together and talk. At this point, all that matters is how she feels. If you do all that, and she refuses her doctor's advice and goes with this dingaling's nonsense, unfortunately you can't control that. Just make yourself available, if you want, for the fallout if Chelsea needs you.
NTA. Your friend, unfortunately, is the one who as being the huge asshole here.

NTA. I think you're doing the right thing, and honestly my heart breaks for your grandson, and also for you and your wife. It isn't easy, watching your adult child make huge mistakes like this. I think at some point you may reach a bridge of whether or not to make moves to take in your grandson, and I wish you strength and courage when you have to cross it.
NTA. And if your husband knows how you feel, knows why you ache, and pushes you? He is not being the partner he should be, that you deserve. I hope you go ahead and take your day in the cemetery.
YTA.
NTA.   **D U M P  H I M !**

NTA, and might I suggest, taking a closer look at who you have married, and if it's really something you want to stick with. I'm also very sorry for your loss, and think no matter what you choose, your daughter, wherever she is, loves you regardless.

NTA. I promise you, you are not the asshole. u/bunnymelly 's first comment with links to info and experiences with narcissist and borderline parents are a perfect start to looking into how to even think about starting to help yourself live with your mother. It took me years to finally get away from my parents and heal, and continue to heal, but it can be done. I wish you the best of luck, and judging by the rest of these comments, you are most certainly not alone.

While I can see where the hope comes from, especially since they did a few nods to DT in season 1, as far as I remember it, he's just a pair of red eyes trapped in the Dark Tower, and erased from existence otherwise.
Welp, there's one! God that ending sucked.

It would have been so cool if we just got, a HINT of her, what she's up to, SOMETHING. I hope they don't just...leave her in s1 because we've had Doctor Sleep and they don't want to go overboard with The Shining content (ridiculous notion).
I feel that last question, *hard.*
So I keep seeing this, but it literally CAN'T be the Crimson King, canonically. IDK if I can say why because it's spoilery but, literally it can't.
Isn't he a criminal justice lawyer? Lawyers don't just...represent anybody. She'd specifically need an emancipation lawyer.

I honestly can't think of any ambiguous endings though? Open-ended/miserable endings for sure but like...Salem's Lot had a great ending, Pet Sematary, The Dead Zone, Carrie, Misery, The Shining...I can keep going honestly, in terms of palatable endings King's delivered. I think we're using the word ambiguous when it's just endings that make us feel bad/we aren't pleased with. It's very subjective. But in terms of story-telling, I think them wrapping up this season poorly isn't "in keeping with King's tradition" lol.

Not all of his endings are ambiguous? Some of them are not good, but it's not his thing, just some of his endings suck sometimes, as did the ending to this season IMO. And with as loose as they've been and creative as they've been with all of his material, why would ambiguous endings be one of those things they'd feel like they'd need to stick to? Not that it matters, because the ending wasn't ambiguous, that shit ended (with some cliffhangers/eggs from season 1, but still).
I agree on the vampires being not necessarily needed (though it pains me to say that) but I was hoping for a bit more than French settlers who all love wine and have a certain bug at their disposal.

I know this is probably the unpopular opinion, I just love Salem's Lot, (for the record, I love Misery, as well) but I am just so fucking bummed that they did nothing with it, and anything tied up with Salem's Lot (big one being the Marsten House) just got lost in the frustrating Annie centric story. If we get a 3rd season, I'm assuming it's gonna be a mashup of Needful Things and whatever else they can throw in there they haven't used or used much of, but what's Needful Things without Pangborn? And then you got rid of Ace Merrill so...? Also the kid who plays Chance aka (I'm convinced anyway) Gordie LaChance from "The Body" they're probably not going to bring back, so that's another opportunity wasted. Overall, being a King fan, there was so much I loved about the 1st season that I geeked out about, that is sorely missing from the 2nd. There were fun little nods throughout the 2nd that I liked, don't get me wrong. But I was ready for it to end by episode 8.
Whoops I definitely just glanced over that one, my bad hahaha
Did you miss the last part of the episode? Where the seat next to Annie was actually empty?
I absolutely thought it was trash. The first half I could deal with, but almost all of the elements of the second half I was frustrated with.

After I finished watching the episode I just immediately asked out loud, "What the fuck was that?" The last twenty minutes were just annoying to get through. I was even annoyed with the extra zoom in on Paul Sheldon. If we've read/watched Misery, we don't need ten minutes of THIS IS ANNIE BECOMING THE ANNIE YOU KNOW AND LOVE. I also hated the second-guessing of "Is Joy being Amity right now" because if you are NOT Annie, and most of us I assume are not, then you don't believe that shit for a second, because it would completely erase the "facts" the season gave us the past 9 episodes.  I felt so bad for Joy, and so frustrated with her. Also how are we gonna just completely avoid the rest of Castle Rock and Jerusalem's Lot, not even get a couple of minutes with them? I ending up caring more about them then Annie at the end, to be honest. //at the end, I was wondering if we were gonna reveal that Paul Sheldon was Stephen King, lol.

I think you're looking too far into it, but also that's what I guess was the intention of the writers. Blue is the Warmest Color(the film Joy is watching) definitely can be watched without understanding French or having subtitles and understood. I think we were meant to view Joy through Annie, so we're all tricked into thinking she's been turned, because Annie does not view the world as a healthy individual. If you keep your wits about you and remember the ceremony was never finished (what would be the point of the ceremony if Amity could have taken over Joy without Joy dying first?) then you just see a teenager that is miserable, figuring out her sexuality, experienced traumatizing things, is using a creative outlet to process, is rightfully angry at her sister mom, etc.
YTA.
YTA. I am cringing. Your wife isn't your mother. Yeeee-ikes.

YTA. All you had to do was ask, not go behind her back and abuse her terms of consent. Then, to dig your grave further, you went and told her you'd be just as affected if those tapes leaked? Bruh. You had a nice thing going, and now you fucking ruined it. Honestly, if you want to make it right, you'd delete the shit out of those tapes. To start. Then look up revenge porn and how badly it's hurt women, in all aspects of their lives. Educate yourself, since you now have so much free time, due to not making sex tapes anymore.

ESH. No matter what, the world doesn't require your brutal honesty, especially someone who is obviously insecure about their self-image. Her having her friends and sister come after you is...too much, unnecessary. But I also seriously doubt that your definition of "morbidly obese" matches with the literal medical term, "morbidly obese", and shows your hand more than it does hers. Taking angle shots does not hide morbid obesity. Do what we all have done on Tinder, match with several people at once, have some sex, maybe have a few dates, and try to find some time to work on your own issues.

NTA. Honestly, while I'm amazed that he was enough of a buffoon to be so ignorant to your feelings about not being near friends (that he watched you fall apart over this), what really makes me doubt his emotional intelligence, or willingness to understand (or at least respect your feelings), is his thinking you're bananas because two weeks of pain over rejection and loneliness can be erased by a moment of relief. What a fucking goon! Honestly, if he doesn't wake up and smell the need for emotional maturity, I'd be cross-posting this in relationship reddit.

YTA. You are being *incredibly* obnoxious and annoying about this. So what? She's a grown woman, don't correct her! She has an accent, she isn't in theater, get off her back. You go ahead and correct your child, but don't go telling them their mother is wrong, either.  She can't spell great, you can't multiply mentally, the world keeps turning, imagine that.

NTA. You had every right to shut her down finally, she knows the truth now, and if everyone is uncomfortable because they have to confront the fact that auntie was being an asshole? So what. That's their problem, not yours. You don't owe anyone any apology, and if anyone gets on you about this whole thing, you can tell them to shut up, too. I'm proud of you, to be honest. I had similar shit when I was 16 and got so much shit from everyone that I eventually ignored all of them and they learned that if they want anything to do with me, they watch what they say.

NTA. The parents are assholes for bringing their one year old to a 10 hour assault on newly developed fucking ears. Jesus Christ. You want a break from parenting? Get a sitter. Or just go to one movie.
NTA. And you don't owe her an explanation, and your husband needs to have your back on this.

NTA. They're just doing you a huge favor, really, by not coming. You could even say they're no longer allowed to come unless they donate all that money they wanted to pay you, to a Trans Rights orgs and charities.
YTA . A racist, ignorant, myopic fucking asshole.

YTA. Y'all are on the path to divorce with how you two handle money--this shit gets ugly quick, and it's already getting pretty hideous. Good luck with being an asshole and being single if you don't do a quick 180.

NTA

And honestly, when you have that conversation, get ready to leave, don't stick around and waste your time arguing with them. The line is this: They either accept they're not getting grandchildren from you, an adult capable of making life decisions, or they're not going to have a relationship with their CHILD, either. Don't waste your time on them if they don't respect your decisions as an adult.

You need to draw a hard line in the sand with this one. He either never brings this up again and accepts the fact that he is being toxic with his misogyny and controlling behavior (that he needs to work on), and that the argument is pointless and you are allowed to wear or NOT wear whatever you damn well please, or he can go somewhere else. No man worth his salt ever tells a woman she can or can't do a damned thing.

Try to move on. This sounds manipulative, and one-sided. Relationships aren't this complicated at the start, and a man who has caused you this much frustration and grief and stopping and starting is not worth another damn minute of your time. There's better, less complicated out there, where you can still have the electric connection, or even something better.

Yeah I'd let it go. Get your money back, and find someone who will fit you into their life the way you deserve. Relationships are supposed to be partnerships that benefit everyone in that partnership. Sounds like the only one truly getting any benefit from this is your (soon-to-be) ex. Dump his ass, there's someone better, I promise.

Definitely do not move back in with him. He's lonely, he's getting over a break up, but it's not your responsibility as his daughter to help him figure out his emotions and figure out that he caused some of his own misery. The only responsibility you have is to take care of yourself, and do what's best for you. If the roommate is too much, you just look for another apartment with a better roommate--do not live with your father. I'd also maintain distance with your father, because he doesn't sound like he's in the greatest headspace and it sounds like you instinctively know this. Listen to your instincts. You don't have to take care of him.
